    Re:   LISP.INI on TWENEX

    The LISP.INI file for TWENEX should probably by default be
    on the HOME: device rather than PS:?  What is presently
    the analogous thing on ITS?
Sure it should.  TWENEX should *HAVE* a HOME: device!  TWENEX suffers from
confusion between working-dir and home-dir in many other ways.  Ever try to
make a directory you have READ access to but not WRITE access your working
directory?
